chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Danny's plays: Meatball Charlie and The Road Is Rugged
summary: Danny mentions plays and stories he wrote, which Milt had seen him writing on the bandstand with Cab.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: What about that play you wrote, Danny?
I've got it all there. Somebody's going to take that meatball thing I did...
Yeah, what was the name of that?
I've got other stories. The Road Is Rugged, about a White couple believing(?) they're Black.
Some of that has come to pass...
Sure. I've seen you sit and write some of that stuff right on the bandstand when we was with Cab.
